notes: BURM 0.26.2: finishing a building stage no longer drops the connection. The client now reads server numbers exactly, so a freshly built foundation or stage can no longer make it reject the world and reconnect. The same fault could stop a server loading its own checkpoint after a restart. The client log also records why a connection was lost. Compatible with 0.26.0 and 0.26.1 clients and servers; older clients keep the fault until they update.
